expect_red: sweep: which occurrence a body is, is decided by distance -- nearest wins, a tie refuses, and too far refuses

mutations.contract: Five pitch arms, five pitch links, three mounts: which occurrence a body is, is decided by agreement with the solved joint point, and a nearest that is too far away or tied with its runner-up refuses rather than guessing.
mutations.note: The mutation drops the acceptance radius, keeping the nearest-wins arm that every happy-path check exercises. A body whose occurrence is simply not in the store then gets drawn at whatever was least far away -- a wrong solid, silently, which is the one failure this whole surface is supposed to make impossible.
